column3:
Go to the application form, skip to page 2 (About) using the progress bar

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply
Select Mexico or Indonesia in "Publisher's country"

column4: Below the checkbox there is an explanatory paragraph beginning "We are launching a pre-assessment checklist..." and ending "...please see our blogpost"
Below that there are two separate lines: "For Mexican journals, please use the Spanish version" and "For Indonesian journals, please use the English version"
The two lines use the same font size and spacing as the paragraph above them
The DOAJ blog announcement post (blog.doaj.org/2026/09/28/...) opens in a new tab
The Mexico (Spanish-language) checklist Google Form opens in a new tab
The Indonesia (English-language) checklist Google Form opens in a new tab

column3: Click the "pre-assessment checklist" link in the checkbox label

column4: The checklist for the selected country opens in a new tab
